description: Takes your list with one row per task (task, person who does it, backup, documented yes/partly/no, frequency, criticality, leaving date if known) and returns a traffic light per task, the knowledge monopolies (people who do three or more tasks without a backup), and the order for the knowledge transfer with one action per task. Red: no backup, not documented and critical, or the person leaves within six months without backup or documentation. Yellow: score of five points or more. Deterministic scoring, no AI, nothing stored. To record a handover use build_handover_file. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

as_of.description: Optional: reference date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (Europe/Berlin).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: One row per task: task, person, backup, documented (yes, partly, no), frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly), criticality (high, medium, low), leaving (date, optional). German column names work too (aufgabe, person, vertretung, dokumentiert, haeufigkeit, kritikalitaet, austritt).

name: check_knowledge_risk
title: Knowledge risk check: which tasks only one person can do, what is not written down, and the order for the knowledge transfer
